title: Lazy nested-savepoint materialization moonshot
impact: Moonshot: tested whether nested transactions could defer SAVEPOINT creation and fuse SAVEPOINT + first write into one writer-isolate request, avoiding public API growth while challenging the eager-savepoint assumption. Rejected: empty nested bodies improved sharply (-77.9% / -74.5%), but the representative one-write nested fanout regressed in both orderings (+74.8% / +34.9%), rollback was neutral-to-slower, and the depth-5 chain slowed (+6.3% / +7.2%). Runtime prototype is preserved at `archive/exp-212`; final branch keeps only the evidence.
